- 项目路径: /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie
- 环境: `source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base`

之前的 Worker 在服务器上用 nohup 启动了修复后的 `compute_bootstrap_ci_llama.py`（修复了 str() 转换和 registry alignment 容差），但 Worker 进程本身中断了。需要检查 nohup 是否跑完了。

### 步骤

1. **检查 bootstrap 是否已完成**
   ```bash
   # 检查结果文件
   cat /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/outputs/bootstrap_ci_results_llama_v2.json 2>/dev/null || echo "NOT_FOUND"
   
   # 检查可能的其他文件名
   ls -la /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/outputs/*llama*bootstrap* 2>/dev/null || echo "NO_FILES"
   ls -la /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/*bootstrap*llama* 2>/dev/null || echo "NO_FILES"
   
   # 检查 nohup.out
   cat /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/nohup.out 2>/dev/null | tail -50 || echo "NO_NOHUP"
   
   # 检查是否还在跑
   ps aux | grep bootstrap | grep -v grep
   ```

2. **如果结果文件存在且完整**，读取并报告：
   - 对每个比较（SciERC R-F1, SciERC E-F1, DocRED R-F1, DocRED E-F1）：
     - point_estimate (unconstrained 和 constrained)
     - delta (pp)
     - 95% CI [lower, upper]
     - p-value
   - Registry alignment 验证（容差 ≤0.05pp）：
     | 实验 | Registry R-F1 (×100) | Registry E-F1 (×100) |
     |------|---------------------|---------------------|
     | Llama SciERC U | 2.68 | 23.56 |
     | Llama SciERC S1 | 2.54 | 23.49 |
     | Llama DocRED U | 5.98 | 55.65 |

3. **如果 bootstrap 没跑完或没跑**：

   - 直接运行（不用 nohup，在前台等）：

     ```bash
     cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie && python compute_bootstrap_ci_llama.py
     ```

   - 等结果出来后报告

4. **如果脚本报错**，报告完整错误信息。

### 关键
- 这是论文最后一个 blocker，必须拿到结果

- 报告必须包含 registry alignment 验证：每个 point estimate 与 registry 值的 delta

\section{Per-Relation Violation Analysis (Llama-3.1-8B)}\label{app:llama-per-relation}

Table~\ref{tab:llama-per-relation-dr} presents the per-relation domain--range violation breakdown for Llama-3.1-8B on DocRED under full S1 constraints.
The Llama baseline exhibits an RV rate of 16.03\%, substantially lower than Qwen's 29.66\%, indicating stronger baseline vocabulary compliance.
% exp_ids: llama_docred_unconstrained (RV=16.03%), qwen_docred_unconstrained (RV=29.66%)
Full S1 completely eliminates RV violations and reduces the residual DR rate to 2.55\% (418/16{,}368 triples), with only three relations exceeding 10\%.
% exp_ids: llama_docred_full_s1 (DR=2.6%, 418/16368)

\centering
\caption{Top 10 per-relation DR violation rates for Llama-3.1-8B on DocRED under full S1 constraints. Relations with $>$20 triples and 0\% DR (e.g., P131, P206, P361, P170, P86) are omitted.}
\label{tab:llama-per-relation-dr}
\begin{tabular}{@{}llrrr@{}}
\toprule
Relation & PID & Triples & DR Violations & DR Rate (\%) \\
\midrule
dissolved/demolished & P576 & 73 & 24 & 32.9 \\
followed by          & P156 & 117 & 24 & 20.5 \\
unemployment rate    & P1198 & 15 & 3 & 20.0 \\
end time             & P582 & 130 & 21 & 16.2 \\
instance of          & P31  & 290 & 37 & 12.8 \\
product/material produced & P1056 & 98 & 11 & 11.2 \\
location of formation & P740 & 81 & 8 & 9.9 \\
